text:
kai: Quick heads-up — drafting PRD + launch gates for kernel choice and KV cache policy. Need customer asks (ACME latency p95 50ms) and acceptance criteria. Ping @maria @chris for runtime constraints.

maria: Ack. Can we prioritize a low-latency path for short seqs (<128) first? ACME is chat-first, long context is later.

chris: Agree. Also call out a fallback policy when quant kernels misbehave — acceptance criteria should include <=1% generation diffs vs baseline on our eval set.

anya: Proposed rollout plan: canary 5% -> monitor 24h -> 25% -> 100%. Metrics to track: p95_latency, cost_per_token, error_rate, quality_regressions.

dev-bot: Deploy job started for branch kernel-launch-gates at commit abc123 (CI: unit tests passed).

laura-product: From product/customer: must support pin-to-version and SLA for Dedicated customers. ACME expects deterministic latency under bursty load.

kai: Draft acceptance criteria for PRD — quick sketch: 1) p95 latency for seq<128 under 75ms in hosted; 2) quality delta <1% on eval set; 3) auto-fallback on kernel error_rate>2%; 4) rollout MUST have automated rollback.

kai: Minimal rollout config idea (to include in RFC):
```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  monitor: [p95_latency, quality_regression, error_rate]
  rollback_on: error_rate>0.02 or quality_regression>0.01
```

maria: Edge cases to capture in PRD: long-context (>2048) routing to slow-but-robust kernel; mixed-precision mismatch causing NaNs; KV hot-keys causing cache churn — enforce per-session KV cap and eviction policy.

chris: Test plan notes: need deterministic eval harness + offline A/B on a 5k prompt set (include adversarial prompts). Gate: quality delta measured by BERTScore and token-level NLL < threshold.

anya: Ops asks: circuit-breaker thresholds, observability tags per request (kernel_id, model_variant), and cost-estimation model for Dedicated billing. Also include a plan for synthetic traffic during canary.

sre-oncall: Oncall input: if canary spikes error_rate, auto-fail to baseline within 60s and page SRE. We'll wire synthetic probes that hit p95 SLA.

laura-product: Quick Q: can we expose model_variant + kernel_id in Console traces for customers? ACME wants per-request debugging.

kai: Yes — plan to expose model_variant and kernel_id in traces (redact token content). Add docs + privacy note. Also will add a runbook for rollback and mitigation steps.

maria: I'll open the RFC PR with a checklist: PRD, rollout YAML, eval harness repo link, runbook, k8s operator change, and perf benchmark matrix.

chris: LGTM. Schedule a 30m sync after the RFC lands. :thumbsup:
